notes.title: Takkoman -Kouzatsu World- is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Interweaving the vibe and worldview of the Touhou Project series with the chaotic sensibilities of the old-school internet, [b]Takkoman - Kouzatsu World- is now available on Steam![/b]

This title is a derivative work based on the Touhou Project, developed by the two-person dojin circle known as illuCalab. - known for games such as GENSOU Skydrift and A Magical High School Girl. 

Takkoman - Kouzatsu World- brings its A-game when it comes to crazy and stylish 2D bullet hell action!
"Defeat the mini and main bosses in each stage. Show them who's the real boss! 
Gracefully sidestep waves of enemy fire!

Strike fear into the bad guys with a rich variety of attacks!"


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732480/Takkoman_Kouzatsu_World/
